data.name: Chiggy Pigg & The Great Drought
data.detailed_description:
Chiggy Pigg is a sci-fi Action-Adventure RPG where you play in a fantasy desert setting as a Pink Fairy Armadillo. You'll explore a fictional desert world saving its inhabitants from the worlds scorching conditions.

Featuring a unique blend of gameplay styles, Chiggy Pigg includes: fast paced movement, arcade-style shooting, minimalistic hack-and-slash combat, platforming, and a slim-but-rich story, all bundled with the spirit of a classic collectathon. All of these mechanics are unified into a cohesive experience that includes addicting mini-games and plenty of optional environmental puzzles to solve. There's something for everyone!

Prepare for an understated, light-hearted adventure!

Chiggy Pigg is intended to be played with a gamepad.

data.short_description: A non-linear sci-fi adventure featuring cute desert themed characters. Restore life to world and get to know the people within it. There are plenty of mysteries to discover along the way.
